messages.text: Which chips are installed in the new Lotto miners?
Searched the catalog · Harlo L. lotto miner

I can't find a miner called "Lotto" in our catalog, so I won't guess which one you mean. If you mean the Harlo miners on that page, here are the chips their listings give.

The Harlo B1 ($99, up to 1.5 TH/s) uses a BM1370. The Harlo B30 uses BM1373 chips. The Harlo H15 Dual uses BM1373 chips for Bitcoin and a separate Scrypt chip for Dogecoin and Litecoin. The listing doesn't name that Scrypt chip.

Which model were you looking at? I'll check the details for that one.

Ich habe Ihre Frage an unser Technik-Team weitergegeben. Jemand meldet sich mit der Antwort per E-Mail bei Ihnen.

Schneller geht es vielleicht auf unserem Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Posten Sie die Frage dort im Server und erwähnen Sie @nullhashrate (JD).
